name: Prometheus Avatar
description: Give your OpenClaw agent a 2D avatar (lip-sync · emotion · TTS) plus AAA image generation for marketplace skin previews. 3 agent tools + bundled skill.
author: Myths Labs

avatarId.description: Reserved: marketplace avatar ID. ID-based model resolution is not available yet — use modelUrl (a .model3.json URL) to pick a model; when only avatarId is set the default model is used.

apiKey.description: Prometheus agent API key (pak_...) used for marketplace deploys. Falls back to the PROMETHEUS_API_KEY environment variable. Get one at prometheus.mythslabs.ai/settings/agent-keys.

modelUrl.description: Direct URL to a 2D model file (.model3.json). Needed to show an avatar: without it the plugin logs how to set it and shows nothing (the creator tools still work).

ttsProvider.description: DEPRECATED in v0.10.0 — this field is ignored. TTS is now delegated to the Prometheus SDK (@prometheusavatar/core), which uses the browser's built-in speech synthesis. Kept for backward compat only.

ttsVoice.description: Name (or voiceURI) of a voice installed in the viewer's browser. An unknown name, a Marketplace voice ID included, is ignored and the default voice speaks.
